value.style_rationale: One team, no independent scaling need; seams allow later split.

technology_choices.rationale: Appointments need transactional integrity across tables.
technology_choices.tradeoffs: Flexible clinical notes need a JSONB column.

scalability_notes: Single instance is sufficient at the stated scale.
security_notes: Role-based access on every patient-scoped endpoint.
value.reasoning: One team, no independent scaling requirement, and two closely coupled domains: a modular monolith with clean seams is correct here, and distribution would be a cost with no matching benefit. PostgreSQL over MongoDB because appointments need transactional integrity across tables; the cost is that flexible clinical notes need a JSONB column.
concerns: NFR-01 still names no roles, so the access-control design rests on an assumption rather than a stated requirement.
value.approval_reason: Technology selection commits the project to PostgreSQL.
